name: Yangyang

tierList.prydwen: Hybrid: T4 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: Free 4-star Aero Sword Hybrid with one of the fastest rotations in the game and a unique Outro that funnels Resonance Energy to the incoming character (rather than a DMG buff), making her the only fully quickswap-friendly Hybrid buffer in the game (no Outro effect lost on swap). Low base value; scales heavily with Sequences (S4-S6).

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Feather as Blade (4 hits), Aero.
skills.resonanceSkill: Zephyr Domain - pull + Aero AoE hit, grouping.
skills.forte: Echoing Feathers - governs Melody (max 3) -> Heavy Attack: Stormy Strike / Mid-air Attack: Feather Release (big burst, consumes all Melody).
skills.liberation: Wind Spirals - pull + Aero AoE hit.
skills.intro: Cerulean Song - launches target, Aero hit, +8% self Aero DMG Bonus for 8s.
skills.outro: Whispering Breeze - restores 4 Resonance Energy/s for 5s (20 total) to next character.

bestWeapons: Lunar Cutter (81.6%, best short field time)
echoSet: Moonlit Clouds (best support - 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro)

teams.name: Xiangli Yao Team
teams.notes: Best quickswap synergy - Xiangli Yao's many swap-cancel windows pair perfectly with Yangyang's fast rotation.

teams.name: Changli Team
teams.notes: Strong only under a true quickswap playstyle; falls off significantly otherwise.

teams.name: Carlotta Team
teams.notes: Budget alternative to Zhezhi even without quickswap.

rotation: Basic 3 -> Heavy -> Zephyr Song -> Ultimate (cancel endlag) -> Basic 1 -> Heavy -> Zephyr Song -> Skill (cancel endlag) -> Jump (cancel Skill endlag) -> Mid-air: Feather Release -> Outro. Intro skipped in the optimized rotation (too slow) unless quickswapping.
communityNotes: Prydwen: one of the only grouping-capable Supports and the sole fully quickswap-friendly Hybrid buffer (energy funnel instead of an expiring DMG buff), but no meta relevance without heavy Sequence investment (S4-S6) and quickswap execution - free and budget-viable but far from optimal without both.
